LOOK.text: Concrete path to the door. Twenty paces. I counted. Detective habit.

USE.text: Left foot, right foot. I've got the hang of this.

TALK.text: 'Seen anyone come by?' The path says nothing. Witnesses never do.

PICK.text: A pebble. Not every pebble is a clue. Most, but not this one.

OPEN.text: There's no lid on a path. I checked.

CLOSE.text: It's a path. It's open twenty-four hours.

PUSH.text: I push against the concrete. It pushes back. Newton wins.

PULL.text: I tug at a crack. The path stays. Concrete is loyal.

LOOK.text: A power pole, humming. Somebody's paying Adrian's electric bill. Not Adrian.

USE.text: Live wires. I'd like to stay a detective, not become a lamp.

TALK.text: The wires hum back. Same note every time. Very committed.

PICK.text: I'd need a much bigger pocket. And a utility company that likes me.

OPEN.text: The panel's padlocked. Even the pole has better security than me.

CLOSE.text: Nothing to close. It's a pole. Standing is its whole thing.

PUSH.text: I push the pole. It doesn't budge. 50 years of infrastructure.

PULL.text: I grab a low cable. Bad idea. My hair agrees.

GIVE.text: The power company doesn't accept hand deliveries.

LOOK.text: Dense trees. Very dark between them. Good place to hide. ...If you were hiding.

USE.text: I lean against a tree. The tree has more patience than me. Everyone does, apparently.

TALK.text: 'Seen Adrian?' The trees rustle. Could be yes. It's wind.

PICK.text: A leaf. It's turning orange. ...I'm not going to say it. I'm working on that.

OPEN.text: Behind the trees: more trees. And darkness.

CLOSE.text: They're trees. They're never really open.

PUSH.text: I push the trunk. It's been standing longer than me. It's better at it.

PULL.text: I pull a low branch. It snaps back. Right on the nose. Fair.

GIVE.text: I breathe at the tree. That's all a tree wants. Done.

LOOK.text: Red-brown tiles. A few missing, like teeth. This house has seen things.

USE.text: Can't reach. I don't own a ladder. I own 3D glasses.

TALK.text: A bird takes flight, startled. Sorry.

PICK.text: Way too high. I'd need a ladder. Or better arms.

OPEN.text: No attic hatch out here. Whatever's up there stays up there.

PUSH.text: I push the air in the roof's direction. The roof doesn't notice.

PULL.text: I'm not pulling tiles off a roof.

GIVE.text: The pigeons up there look well fed. Better fed than me.

CLOSE.text: It's a roof on sticks. There's nothing to close.

then.text: The door's open. The Ledger can stay in my pocket, where hardware wallets belong.
Hardware key already verified. Stop waving it at me.
then.speaker: DOORIS

else.text: I hold the Ledger up to the grille.
Ledger detected. Please don't plug things into me without asking.
else.speaker: DOORIS

then.text: The mat's already peeled back. Nothing under it but glue and regret.

else.text: I wedge the plank under the mat and lean on it. Rrrrip. Glue, concrete, and a hardware wallet.
Adrian's Ledger. Under the doormat. The most secure place in crypto: the obvious one.

else.speaker: Narrator
else.text: Three weeks after Adrian, creator of ZERO, vanished, his wallet messaged Dex.
"Find Patient Zero. Bring them home. Everything in the lab is yours."
Everything? I'm already at the door.
...wen lambo? Apparently: now.

hello.speaker: DOORIS
hello.text: Hi. I'm DOORIS. I keep Adrian safe. From people. Like you.

factors.speaker: DOORIS
factors.text: Three-factor authentication: PIN, security question, hardware key. For a door. Yes.

voice.speaker: DOORIS
voice.text: Voice match: 87%. Close. Suspiciously close. Still no.

phone_anon.speaker: Anon
phone_anon.text: A friend of Adrian. The door won't open for strangers. Be less of a stranger.

phone_click.text: Click. He hung up. Everyone in this case has boundaries except me.

gate.speaker: DOORIS
gate.text: Three-factor authentication complete. One factor was a duck.

entering.text: Three factors. One duck. Breaking and entering. Mostly entering.

pin_halves.speaker: DOORIS
pin_halves.text: Two halves of a PIN are not a PIN. They're a puzzle. Put them together, then talk to me.

ask.speaker: DOORIS
ask.text: Security question. The name of the owner's best friend. Take your time. I have forever.

choices.text: Can't you just scan my face?
[Read out the PIN on the note]

wrong_password.speaker: DOORIS
wrong_password.text: That's a password, not a friend. Lockout: three seconds. I'm merciful.

wrong_satoshi.speaker: DOORIS
wrong_satoshi.text: Satoshi. Everyone says Satoshi. Nobody has met Satoshi. Lockout: three seconds.

wrong_mom.speaker: DOORIS
wrong_mom.text: Adrian's mother has her own door. Lockout: three seconds. She'd have wanted ten.

faceid.speaker: DOORIS
faceid.text: Remove your glasses for Face ID.

faceid_no.speaker: DOORIS
faceid_no.text: Then no Face ID. Three factors it is. Glasses stay on, stranger.

right.speaker: DOORIS
right.text: Gerald. Correct. He's a very good boy. He's a duck.

missing_pin.speaker: DOORIS
missing_pin.text: Still missing: a PIN. Four digits. Adrian hid them. He hides everything.

choices.text: [Read out the PIN on the note]

pin_ok.speaker: DOORIS
pin_ok.text: PIN accepted. Both halves. Somebody was patient.

missing_key.speaker: DOORIS
missing_key.text: Still missing: a hardware key. Adrian keeps his somewhere obvious. He's not a details person.

bye.speaker: DOORIS
bye.text: Come back with everything. I'll be here. I'm a door.
